title: Delete an OrbStack virtual machine
summary: Remove a virtual machine and its data from your Mac. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

steps.explain: Delete a virtual machine by name. Replace <VM_NAME> with the name of the VM you want to remove.

placeholders.name: VM_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the virtual machine to delete.

warnings: Deleting a VM permanently removes all data inside it. Ensure you have backed up any important files before proceeding.

rollback.explain: There is no command to undo a VM deletion. You must recreate the VM and restore data from backups.
